thread:
Ava Ruiz: Quick sync — finalizing the launchpad email sequence for next Tuesday. Draft in the doc: https://drive.redwood.ai/launchpad-email-v2. Want a 3-email nurture + webinar invite path.
Sanjay Patel: Thanks — I'll review seg targeting. Main Q: should we treat webinar registrants separately from generic launch recipients? @Marta thoughts?
Marta Chen: Yes. Webinar registrants get an exclusive reminder stream + 'attended' suppression. Non-registrants get the 3-email nurture that ends with a webinar invite CTA.
Leo Novak: Suggest splitting non-registrants into 2 cohorts: "active-engagers" (opened last 30d or clicked) and "cold". Different subject lines & send cadence.
Ben Ortiz: Agree. Proposed segments (SQL-like):
```
-- active-engagers
SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE last_engagement_at > now() - interval '30 days' AND email_opt_in = true;
-- cold
SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE last_engagement_at <= now() - interval '30 days' AND email_opt_in = true;
```
Sanjay Patel: Perfect. For tracking: UTM params = utm_medium=email&utm_source=launchpad&utm_campaign=orbit_nudge_v1. Also add header X-Redwood-Mail: launchpad-orbit.
Ava Ruiz: Subject line variants for A/B test:
- A: "See how Redwood cuts inference cost by 3x — live demo"
- B: "Reduce LLM latency and cost — webinar + 3 quick wins"
Keep language technical but outcome-focused.
Marta Chen: For the cold cohort, softer subject lines and 1 fewer email (2-email drip). For active-engagers, we do 3 emails + webinar invite 48h before.
Leo Novak: Send windows: test two windows for APAC/EU/NA. Primary send at 10am local; backup at 4pm local. Stagger sends to avoid rate spikes.
Ben Ortiz: Can ops confirm we have rate limits set for the dedicated pool? @deploy-bot can you post current throttle config?
deploy-bot: Current email send throttle for marketing batch jobs: 2500 msgs/min per region; burst cap 5000 for 10m. Logs: https://ops.redwood.ai/batch-throttle
Sanjay Patel: Good. Metric targets for launch week: open rate 20% (avg), CTR 3.5%, webinar sign rate 6% for active-engagers. We'll monitor in Looker dashboard "marketing.launchpad.orbit_v1".
Ava Ruiz: CTA variants — primary should be "Join the demo" (web), secondary for cold = "Learn how" (docs). Use shorter preheader for mobile.
Marta Chen: Suppression rules: suppress users who converted on trial in last 90d and anyone who unsubscribed. Also remove recent webinar attendees.
Leo Novak: For the email copy, include 1 benchmark stat (latency/cost) and 1 customer quote. That helped convert during last benchmark push.
Ben Ortiz: I'll draft HTML and make sure the template supports dynamic blocks for region/time and webinar link. ETA EOD Friday.
Ava Ruiz: Action items:
- Ben: template + staging send (EOD Fri)
- Sanjay: finalize SQL segments & export (tomorrow morning)
- Marta: finalize copy + subject lines (tomorrow noon)
- Leo: update send windows & throttling notes (tomorrow)
- I'll own the Looker dashboard alerts during launch week
Everyone: add test recipients to the doc and tag me when you're ready for a test blast. :thumbsup:
Sanjay Patel: Added dev+pm+ops test list to the sheet.
Ben Ortiz: Will run a 100-recipient smoke test after staging deploy — tagging @Ava when done.
Marta Chen: Copy ready on doc v3. Leaving two subject options for the active cohort.
Ava Ruiz: Awesome. Final check-in Monday AM for go/no-go. Thanks team! :rocket:
